item.title: Israeli police bar top Catholic figure in Jerusalem from holding Palm Sunday Mass at Holy Sepulchre
item.summary: Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, the top Catholic figure in Jerusalem, was barred from entering the Church of the Holy Sepulchre to celebrate Palm Sunday Mass, according to his office, in what Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni labelled an "offence to the faithful".
